title: Six more dachshunds rescued from ‘hoarding’ situation as 21 continue to recover in Tampa
summary: A Tampa non-profit said it saved six dachshunds over the weekend from a hoarding situation — and that these dogs are related to the 21 others who were surrendered to Pinellas County Animal Services last week.

title: Tampa woman warns of fentanyl dangers after losing husband and stepson in less than a year
summary: A Tampa woman is sharing her story after losing her husband and stepson to fentanyl overdoses less than a year apart.

title: Met drops John Galliano exhibit following criticism over antisemitic remarks
summary: The Metropolitan Museum of Art is canceling its planned exhibit honoring designer John Galliano following backlash over the designer’s past antisemitic statements.

title: Permits for automated license plate readers revoked: FDOT
summary: The Florida Department of Transportation said it revoked statewide permits for automated license plate recognition (LPR) systems.

title: FTC sues Amazon, alleging it overcharged advertisers
summary: The FTC and 22 states on Monday accused retail giant Amazon of deceiving businesses by overcharging prices to advertise on its massive retail platform, pocketing billions for the company.

title: The shock gloves ICE plans to use could increase the risk of sudden death
summary: ICE approved a deal last week to buy 6,650 electric shock gloves that deliver a low voltage shock upon contact with skin. Their manual warns their use may increase the risk of sudden death.

title: 'Every little bit helps': In Polk County, Dolly’s books need a boost
summary: Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library has paused new registrations in Polk County as United Way of Central Florida seeks more funding, leaving families on a waiting list for free monthly books.

title: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is stepping down, White House says
summary: Secretary of the Army Dan Driscoll is stepping down, the White House confirmed on Monday. The Trump administration did not give a reason for Driscoll's departure.

title: Dengue fever cases rise in Tampa Bay area as Pasco County ramps up mosquito control efforts
summary: Florida reports 41 dengue fever cases, including 30 in Hillsborough County and 2 in Pasco County. Learn how to protect yourself and what officials are doing to help.
